_about: Plain-language text the rules engine uses to explain its verdicts. `reasons` gives a short clause per signal id for the headline ({org} is replaced with the organisation the message names); tactics use their own title from tactics.json. `category_advice` is added to the recommended actions for that scam type. Keep the wording short, concrete and free of jargon: it is read by people who may have just been scammed.

reasons.safe_browsing_hit: Google Safe Browsing lists the link as dangerous
reasons.unsafe_destination: the link redirects to a page Google Safe Browsing lists as dangerous
reasons.embedded_official_domain: the link hides {org}'s real address inside a fake one
reasons.claimed_org_domain_mismatch: the link is not {org}'s real website
reasons.org_domain_mismatch: the link belongs to a different organisation than the one named
reasons.lookalike_domain: the link uses a look-alike of {org}'s web address
reasons.very_new_domain: the website was registered only days ago
reasons.unregistered_domain: the web address isn't even registered
reasons.ip_literal_host: the link is a bare IP address instead of a website name
reasons.reported_scam_number: the phone number has been reported for scams
reasons.strong_pattern_match: it closely matches a known Malaysian scam message
reasons.partial_pattern_match: it resembles a known scam message
reasons.link_with_credential_request: it asks you to log in or verify through a link
reasons.phishing_path_keywords: the link looks like a fake login page
reasons.url_shortener: the real link is hidden behind a short link
reasons.cross_domain_redirects: the link bounces through other websites
reasons.idn_host: the web address uses letters from other alphabets
reasons.high_abuse_tld: the web address ends in a domain type scammers use heavily
reasons.free_hosting: the page is on a free hosting service
reasons.random_looking_domain: the web address looks randomly generated
reasons.excessive_subdomains: the web address is stacked with extra parts
reasons.personal_mobile: it gives a personal mobile number instead of an official line
reasons.international_number: it gives an overseas phone number
reasons.official_domain: the link goes to {org}'s official website
reasons.matches_official_number: the phone number is {org}'s official line
reasons.established_domain: the website has been registered for years
reasons.security_advice: it warns you to keep your codes secret and contains no link
reasons.safe_browsing_clean: Google Safe Browsing has no record of the link

category_advice.bank_phishing: Open your bank's official app, or call the number on the back of your card, to check your account.
category_advice.parcel_courier: Track parcels only in the courier's official app or website, using the tracking number from the shop you bought from.
category_advice.government_impersonation: Government agencies don't demand payment or bank details by SMS or WhatsApp. Check on the agency's .gov.my portal or at its counter.
category_advice.loan_investment: Check lenders on Bank Negara's licensed list and investments on the Securities Commission's investor alert list.
category_advice.job_task: Real employers never ask you to pay to start a job or to withdraw your earnings.
category_advice.prize: You can't win a draw you never entered. Real prizes never need a fee or your banking login.
category_advice.impersonation: Call the person on the number you already have for them before sending anything.
category_advice.malware_apk: Install apps only from Google Play or the App Store.
category_advice.account_takeover: Turn on two-step verification in WhatsApp, Telegram and your email.
category_advice.money_mule: Letting others use your bank account is a crime, even if you didn't know where the money came from.
category_advice.online_shopping: Pay only through the marketplace's checkout, and check sellers on PDRM's Semak Mule site.
category_advice.extortion: Don't pay or reply. Keep the messages and report to the police.
category_advice.utility_telco: Check bills only in the provider's official app or by calling its official careline.

reason_groups._about: Signals in one group are the same finding said different ways; a headline uses at most one of them.
